notes.title: Studio Anniversary & Promotion!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

We're happy to announce that Arrowiz studio is now one year old! To celebrate this milestone and thank all your support, Beats Fever will have a 50%-off special promotion for two weeks starting from 10am Sep. 15 pacific time.

Please enjoy the game and share it with your loved ones~ ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: First DLC (Free) On the Way
notes.notes:
Greetings,

We're happy to announce that the first DLC of Beats Fever will land on Steam in late March and it will be FREE! 

Contents in this DLC:
> Many new music tracks (and a few with lyrics)
> One brand new city/scene

[spoiler]Well, at least it'll be free for a couple of weeks. :) [/spoiler]

Love,
Arrowiz

notes.title: Leaderboard for Every Song!
notes.notes:
We've just deployed the March quick update and the following features are live: ːsteamhappyː 

> Leaderboard for every music track
> A "Restart Level" button for the pause menu
> A few bug fixes and improvements

Please leave a comment/thread if you encounter anything weird with the update.

Also, a brand new city (stage) and many new songs are in the works and we expect to release them before Easter. Stay tuned, folks!

notes.title: First Content Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Features & Changes

> Five new music tracks have been added.
> Five "Fever-class" music tracks have been added. (Yes they're tough!)
> The graphics in city of Rio has been optimized and now looks less "organic".
> The album page status is now remembered, so players won't always return to page one.
> Score hierarchies for certain tracks have been revised so they're in line with others.
> Four new Achievements have been added.
> A few bug fixes, improvements and special contents.

As usual, comments and posts are warmly welcome!

notes.title: First Content Update to Land Soon
notes.notes:
Hi,

After collecting the initial feedback from reviews, threads and emails, we've planned the following for the free content update in February:

> More music tracks
> Difficulty levels for certain tracks
> Graphical optimization for the city of Rio
> Page status memory (so you don't always return to Page 1)

This list may be updated as we work on the content and keep reading community feedback.

Love,
Arrowiz
